title: BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Online Form 2026 (32,388 Posts)
postName: Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 – Primary / TGT / PGT (OTR Registration)
vacancyDetails: Tentative 32,000+ to 46,000 school teacher posts under TRE 4.0 (Primary, Middle, Secondary, Higher Secondary) – final count as per official BPSC notification; OTR is mandatory before apply
qualification: Primary: Intermediate + D.El.Ed / as per NCTE; TGT/PGT: Graduation/PG with B.Ed and CTET/STET as applicable under Bihar TRE rules
ageLimit: Minimum 18 years (Primary); 21 years for TGT/PGT – upper age as per Bihar teacher recruitment rules
applicationFee: OTR: Free / as notified. Main form fee (when open): Gen ~₹750; SC/ST/Women/PwD ~₹200 (indicative from previous TRE)
selectionProcess: OTR Registration → Online Application (when live) → Written Exam → Merit / Document Verification
documentsRequired: Valid email & mobile, photo, signature, educational certificates, TET/CTET where required, category certificate, Aadhaar
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bpsc.bihar.gov.in
2. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) with email and mobile
3. Upload photo and basic details carefully
4. Keep OTR credentials ready for TRE 4.0 apply link (July/August 2026 onwards as scheduled)
5. Fill main application only after official TRE 4.0 notice
shortDescription: BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 OTR Registration 2026 for 32,000+ teacher posts. Complete free OTR at bpsc.bihar.gov.in before the main application opens.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) is conducting the process for School Teacher TRE 4.0 recruitment covering Primary, TGT and PGT levels with a large vacancy pool (reports cite about 32,388+ posts; some updates mention higher tentative figures).

One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before candidates can submit the TRE 4.0 application form when it opens (expected July/August 2026 window as per portal updates).

What to do now

  • Complete OTR on bpsc.bihar.gov.in
  • Keep educational and TET documents scanned
  • Wait for official TRE 4.0 detailed advertisement for exact vacancies, fee and exam dates

Do not rely on unofficial vacancy numbers until BPSC publishes the formal notice.
